2. Application for permit

SCHEDULE

LAWS OF MALAYSIA

LOTTERIES ACT 1952

[ACT 288]

LOTTERIES (APPLICATION FOR PERMIT) REGULATIONS 1953

(Made under section 14)

(Revised—2023)

[29 January 1953]

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Lotteries (Application for Permit)

Regulations 1953.

Application for permit

2. (1) An application for a permit to promote a lottery under the Act shall be

made in writing, in duplicate and in the form specified in the Schedule.

 (2) The application under subregulation (1) shall contain all the particulars

prescribed in the form.

SCHEDULE

[Regulation 2]

LOTTERIES (APPLICATION FOR PERMIT) REGULATIONS 1953

FORM OF APPLICATION FOR A PERMIT TO PROMOTE A LOTTERY

of a permit authorizing……………………………...............................................................................................

1. Full name, address and occupation

of the promoter of the

12. ..............................................................................

tickets sold or other means by

which the lottery/each lottery* is to

13. ..............................................................................

N.B.—In the case of lotteries are to be promoted outside the Federation, the particulars

given should include the details of the local application such as the names,

addresses and occupations of the responsible local officials, and the numbers of

tickets or chances to be offered for sale in the Federation.

The above particulars are to the best of my/our* knowledge and belief true and

complete.

such total amount does not exceed such sum the application should be

addressed to the Menteri Besar of the State or the Yang di-Pertua Negeri of the

State of Malacca or Penang in which the lottery is to be promoted or conducted.
